column1: # Windows programming pages. One row per page, per task it belongs to. Tab-separated; see finder.py for the rules.

column7: summary
Reads the command line, shows message boxes, pumps messages and explains Windows errors.
Reports the Windows version, build, edition and bitness, and the version of any file.
Returns the paths of the Windows, system and temporary folders and of known folders.
Reads and sets a window's text, class, styles and icon, and redraws windows.
Reads and sets a window's position and size in pixels, and centres windows and controls.
Finds a control's form, top-level windows, controls by id, and the windows of a process.
Gives windows a dark title bar and rounded corners, and reads the light or dark setting.
Measures the desktop, the screen, the work area and monitors, and scales values for DPI.
Converts between pixels, points, twips, HiMetric units, DIPs and dialog units.
Creates fonts, reads the fonts Windows uses and changes the font of a window or control.
Puts text and other data on the clipboard, reads it back and empties the clipboard.
Creates, loads, saves and draws bitmaps, captures the screen and saves icons.
Splits paths into folder, name and extension, and detects UTF-16 and UTF-8 text.
Reads raw data embedded in a program's resources into a string or out to a file.
Shows the open, save, folder and colour dialogs, and opens Control Panel applets.
Reads the connection state, combines and cleans URLs, and finds browsers and mail.
Converts case by locale, translates between code pages, formats sizes and splits fields.
Names the web colours twice: as `RGB_*` values for GDI and as `ARGB_*` values for GDI+.
Creates a main window, adds controls to it and runs its message loop, scaled for DPI.
Creates a window that serves as one page of a tab control.
Creates dialog boxes in memory, fills them with controls and shows them modal or modeless.
Extracts control ids, notification codes and pointers from window-message parameters.
Creates a push button that draws itself, with images, toggle behaviour and custom colours.
Creates an edit control that accepts input only in a set shape, such as a phone number.
Creates an off-screen bitmap to draw on with GDI or GDI+, then save, print or display.
Creates a graphic control: a child window that keeps and repaints what you draw on it.
Chooses a printer, measures its page, reads and changes its settings, and prints.
Shows the Windows Open and Save dialogs and reads the files the user picked.
Adds check boxes, lists, buttons and other controls to an open or save dialog.
Handles the events of an open or save dialog and of the controls added to it.
Hosts a Windows Explorer folder view in your window and reports where the user navigates.
Checks, clicks and labels push buttons, check boxes, radio buttons and split buttons.
Sets and reads the text, icon, bitmap, cursor or metafile of a static control.
Reads, changes, selects and formats the text of single-line and multiline edit controls.
Adds, finds, selects and reads the items of a combo box, and sets its list and edit box.
Inserts, reads and changes the items of a ComboBoxEx control, a combo box with images.
Adds, finds, selects and reads the items of a list box control.
Adds columns and rows to a list view and reads, selects, sorts and groups its items.
Adds, finds, expands, selects and styles the items of a tree view control.
Adds, reads, sizes and reorders the columns of a header control.
Adds, selects, renames and removes the tabs of a tab control, and manages its tab pages.
Adds, changes and queries the buttons of a toolbar control and the images they show.
Inserts, moves, sizes and queries the bands of a rebar, the container for toolbars.
Builds menu bars, drop-down and shortcut menus, and reads and changes their items.
Divides a status bar into parts and sets and reads their text, icons and tooltips.
Creates tooltips for controls and windows and sets their text, timing, colours and place.
Sets the range, position, step, colours and state of a progress bar control.
Reads and sets a trackbar's position, range, tick marks, selection and buddy windows.
Reads and sets an up-down control's position, range, base, buddy window and acceleration.
Sets what a pager control scrolls, and reads and sets its position, buttons and colours.
Reads and sets the selected date, range, today and colours of a month calendar control.
Reads and sets the date and time, range, format and drop-down calendar of a date picker.
Opens, plays, stops and closes silent AVI clips in an animation control.
Reads and sets the key combination in a hot key control, and the combinations it refuses.
Reads, sets and clears the address in an IP address control, and limits its four fields.
Shows, hides, enables and positions a scroll bar control, and reads and sets its range.
Measures a SysLink control, reads and sets its links, and finds the link at a point.
Holds a COM `VARIANT` and converts it to and from tiko numbers, strings, dates and arrays.
Holds a COM `SAFEARRAY` and destroys it, with all its elements, when it goes out of scope.
Wraps a COM `BSTR` string and frees it when the variable goes out of scope.
Stores a 96-bit signed integer in a COM `DECIMAL` and does arithmetic on it.
Calls the methods and properties of a COM Automation object by name.
Creates COM objects and handles GUIDs, reference counts, event connections and variants.
Creates a rich edit control in a CWindow and reads and sets its options and formatting.
Selects, finds, inserts and replaces text in a rich edit control, and undoes edits.
Loads, saves and formats rich edit text, and drives its Text Object Model document.
Sends rich edit messages to a control by its handle: text, selection, formatting and RTF.
Reads and sets the character formatting of rich edit text: font, size, colour and effects.
Reads and sets paragraph formatting in rich edit text: indents, spacing, tabs and lists.
Reads, edits, searches and formats a span of rich edit text through the Text Object Model.
Reads and changes the selection of a rich edit control through the Text Object Model.
Inserts table rows into rich edit text and reads and changes row and cell properties.
Reads and replaces the text of a rich edit story and gives ranges over it.
Answers a rich edit control's OLE questions, so that pictures and objects can be pasted.
Lists the Text Object Model interfaces and constants, and the base of the TOM classes.
Draws lines, shapes, text and images with GDI+ on a window, a device context or an image.
Draws lines and outlines in GDI+ with a colour or brush, a width, dashes and caps.
Fills shapes and text in GDI+ with a colour, a hatch pattern, an image or a gradient.
Draws arrow heads and shapes of your own at the ends of lines drawn with a GDI+ pen.
Builds shapes from lines, curves and text, and walks the points they are made of.
Combines rectangles and paths into areas for filling, clipping and hit-testing in GDI+.
Moves, scales, rotates and shears points with a GDI+ affine transformation matrix.
Loads, creates, edits and saves images with GDI+: bitmaps, metafiles and cached bitmaps.
Adjusts the colours of an image as it is drawn: colour matrices, gamma, keys, remapping.
Blurs, sharpens, tints and corrects the colours of bitmaps with the GDI+ effect classes.
Creates GDI+ fonts and font families and lists the fonts installed or loaded from files.
Sets how GDI+ lays out text in a rectangle: alignment, wrapping, trimming and tab stops.
Starts GDI+, builds colours and rectangles, and converts, saves and prints images.
Creates the Direct2D factory that makes render targets, geometries and stroke styles.
Holds Direct2D stroke styles, reads back their settings and locks a multithreaded factory.
Draws shapes, bitmaps and text with Direct2D and creates the brushes and bitmaps it uses.
Draws into windows, device contexts and bitmaps, and saves and restores drawing state.
Paints shapes, lines and text in Direct2D with a colour, a gradient, a bitmap or an image.
Holds pixel images for a Direct2D render target, and the colour profiles they are in.
Measures, hit-tests and reshapes Direct2D geometries; the base class of every shape.
Builds Direct2D shapes from rectangles, ellipses, lines, curves and arcs.
Builds the points, rectangles, colours, matrices and property records Direct2D calls take.
Lists the Direct2D interfaces, structures and enumerations that sys/win/direct2d declares.
Lists the DirectWrite interfaces, enumerations and structures of sys/win/direct2d.
Lists the DXGI interfaces, enumerations and structures of sys/win/direct2d.
Lists the WIC interfaces, enumerations and structures of sys/win/direct2d.
Hosts a Microsoft Edge browser in a window and drives it from tiko code.
Implements the WebView2 callback interfaces as classes to extend, one per event or result.
Lists the WebView2 interfaces, enumerations and structures that sys/win/webview2 declares.
